incident-bot: [ALERT] 1782345600 HIGH - smart-routing: routing_policy_evaluator threw repeated DeprecationMappingError; observed cascading fallbacks and 5xx spikes for hosted-api (us-west -> eu fallback loop)

pagerduty-bot: Paging: @ops-oncall (primary), @alice.k (sre), @ben_t (runtime)

ops-oncall: On it. seeing a ton of reroute logs. latency jump to 2.3s p95 and error rate up 7x for some customers.

alice.k: jumping in. summary? any config change this morning?

ben_t: We rolled a small schema change to routing policy last deploy at 08:12 UTC. It removed support for the deprecated field "region_priority" and added "fallback_order". migration script should have populated a compatibility map but looks like it missed empty lists.

carmen: logs show evaluator returning [] for compatible_variants for some models, so the router falls through to region fallback; region fallback tries other regions but policy default is now to fallback to "closest" and that triggers loops because some variant mappings are asymmetric.

dana: sample log lines: ```
2026-02-27T08:21:03Z INFO evaluator request_id=req_9a1 route=hosted-api model=llama-70B variant=null compatible_variants=[]
2026-02-27T08:21:03Z WARN router request_id=req_9a1 region=us-west fallback_region=eu-west attempt=1
2026-02-27T08:21:04Z WARN router request_id=req_9a1 region=eu-west fallback_region=us-west attempt=2
2026-02-27T08:21:05Z ERROR router request_id=req_9a1 no_compatible_variants -> 502
```

alice.k: so empty compatible_variants -> router keeps attempting region swap until TTL exhausted -> customers see 502s and higher latency. this started when the schema enforcement removed the implicit mapping for deprecated region_priority.

ben_t: I can reproduce locally by sending a policy with the deprecated key omitted; evaluator returns empty unless fallback mapping exists. The migration should have backfilled fallback_order from region_priority but the script used strict validation and skipped records with unknown fields.

ops-oncall: impact: high for hosted-api customers hitting model llama-70B and api routes that use smart-routing default policy. we've got two enterprise customers reporting errors and increased token cost due to retries.

carmen: mitigation plan: 1) short-term: change router to treat empty compatible_variants as "use all compatible_variants_by_default" (a safer fallback) 2) immediate hotfix: reintroduce a compatibility shim that maps region_priority -> fallback_order during runtime 3) roll back the schema enforcement in control-plane 4) notify customers.

alice.k: agree. I can push a runtime shim quickly as a binary hotfix. ben, can you prepare the migration rollback in control plane?

ben_t: will open a revert PR for the schema change now. also creating a one-off migration to backfill missing fallback_order where region_priority existed historically.

deploy-bot: deploy request: runtime-hotfix/shim v1.2 -> staging passed tests -> awaiting prod approval by @alice.k

alice.k: approve deploy-bot. rolling to prod canary first (10%).

ops-oncall: can we also triage traffic shaping? limit retries to 1 while routing is unstable.

dana: changing retry policy to 1 on edge for smart-routing now. patch applied to edge-proxies.

deploy-bot: canary rollout started for runtime-hotfix/shim v1.2 -> canary 10% 

(10 minutes pass)

ops-oncall: canary looks good. error rate down 65% for canary traffic. increasing to 50%

(20 minutes pass)

ops-oncall: 50% looks stable. pushing to 100%

deploy-bot: runtime-hotfix/shim v1.2 -> prod 100% success

alice.k: good. ben, how's the revert PR?

ben_t: revert PR merged and control-plane schema enforcement rolled back. migration script queued to run against affected tenants; will mark as urgent.

carmen: we should notify SRE and CS to contact affected customers. posting a short blurb for status page.

alice.k: creating incident postmortem draft. oncall handoff in 30m: @dana you'll take follow-up owner for migration and CS comms. I'll own postmortem and hotfix rollout notes.

dana: ack. I'll also add a quick unit test to prevent the compatibility shim from being removed in future schema PRs.

sre-lead: add action item: require migration dry-run and fail-safe default mapping in next schema changes. owner: @ben_t, due EOD.

ben_t: noted. also adding automated smoke test against a set of policy permutations so evaluator never returns empty for a valid model.

ops-oncall: final impact summary for pager: ~45 minutes of degraded routing for specific model variants, two enterprise customers with increased 5xx and latency, overall platform error-rate spike ~4.2% during window. No data loss.

pagerduty-bot: Incident acknowledged and closed by ops-oncall at 1782348700.

alice.k: post-incident TL;DR I'll post in #postmortems with timeline, root cause (schema enforcement removed implicit compatibility mapping), mitigations (runtime shim, rollback, edge retry cap), and action items. thanks all for quick turnaround. :heart:

(Hand-off) dana: taking follow-ups: migration backfill, CS outreach, add test coverage. ping me for access or context.

ben_t: dropping the revert/migration PR links here: https://git.internal/redwood/routing/pulls/4823 and migration job: job-2026-02-27-3245

alice.k: closing thread for now. will reopen if we see regressions.
